description: This file contains Data Transfer Object (DTO) classes for authentication-related requests and responses, including login, registration, and token response objects.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for login request containing username and password fields with validation annotations.

classes.name: AuthDtos.RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for registration request including username, email, password, and role fields with validation annotations.

classes.name: AuthDtos.TokenResponse
classes.description: DTO representing a response containing an authentication token.
